item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 12 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 12 #SLPRSD
Issued at 06:00 PM 14 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Romblon(Magdiwang, Romblon, Ferrol, Odiongan, SantaMaria, SanAndres, SanAgustin, Calatrava), #Masbate(Mobo and Uson) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Masbate(Baleno, Aroroy, CityOfMasbate, Monreal, SanJacinto, SanFernando, Batuan, Mandaon, Milagros, Claveria), #Romblon(SanFernando, Cajidiocan, SanJose, SantaFe, Alcantara, Looc), #Sorsogon(Bulan, Irosin and Matnog) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
